title: Analyze a target page for safe m3kit porting

target.x-prompt: Which page/component path should be analyzed?

project.description: Optional Nx project name when the target is ambiguous.

domain.description: Domain name for the porting packet. Inferred from target path when omitted.

page.description: Page/feature name for the porting packet. Inferred from the target filename when omitted.

outputDir.description: Directory for analysis outputs. Defaults to m3kit-porting/<domain>/<page>.

write.description: When false, only logs the analysis; default writes the analysis packet.
